description: §14.8.10 (S455) — a write in an imported module to a table another compiled file declares tenant-scoped is held to the floor. ./writer.scrml INSERTs into `assets` naming `tenant_id` (a forged owner) without `.acrossTenants()`; `assets` is tenant-scoped only by case.scrml's `<schema>`. Before S455 the per-file tenant set left writer.scrml with no tenant table, so the forged INSERT compiled clean. Now it is E-TENANT-WRITE.
rationale: §14.8.10 Write bullet: everything other than an injectable subset write on a tenant table without `.acrossTenants()` is E-TENANT-WRITE — among them "an INSERT that names `tenant_id` (the floor cannot verify the chosen tenant)". S455: the tenant set is the compilation's, so the table is tenant-scoped in every file compiled together.
